spec.name: Halloween Wearable Witch Hat
spec.description: Original Orange SMP Halloween cosmetic: a broad stepped purple brim, hollow head opening, tall crooked crown, burnt-orange ribbon and open copper buckle. Axis-aligned geometry in x/z 0–16 and y 0–20. The head bone anchors the hat at the underside of its brim; no display geometry or animations.

prompt: Wearable crooked tall witch hat, broad flat purple brim, stepped tapering purple cone bent subtly with axis-aligned cuboids, orange band and small copper buckle. Complete item model, no head or body or display stand. Bounds x,z0..16 y0..20. Base brim y0. Vanilla pixel texture and clear silhouette. This is a real 3D cosmetic worn on a player head. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
